LanguageData.VGE_EmergencyGenerator.label: emergency gravship generator
LanguageData.VGE_EmergencyGenerator.description: An emergency power source capable of fully powering a gravship by adjusting its output to match demand. It is designed to be kept for emergencies, as it will always cause a critical breakdown and an EMP detonation when it produces all the power it’s able to generate. It is capable of producing up to 50,000 W/d before it breaks down.
